title: Chapter 128
text:
The players were hesitant, but Han Xiao was not in a hurry. There would always be someone who would take the first bite.

Just as he expected, there was finally a cute girl with the ID 'Maple Moon' who gritted her teeth and spent enough money. Han Xiao then raised the favorability of Maple Moon to five points. Suddenly, he realized that Maple Moon … was someone he knew.

Maple Moon was shocked when she saw the skill list.

"I can actually learn the basic knowledge for class change!"

As soon as this was said, the players were in an uproar, and their excitement soared.

In the past few days, other than the tycoons and those with money, most of the normal players had experienced the difficulty of class change and had no idea how to obtain the basic knowledge. They did not expect this mysterious NPC Black Phantom to teach them the basic knowledge.

[Basic Assembly] has been learned. You have received 1,000 EXP and 200 Aquamarine Dollars.

That's right, compared to the closed beta, Han Xiao had doubled the price of the basic knowledge, and it did not affect the players' enthusiasm at all. Although it only gave 1,000 EXP each time it was learned, there were a lot of players here, and the accumulation was significant.

Originally, the most popular way for Blue Star players to class change was to join a faction. Very few players could obtain the basic knowledge before joining a faction. After joining a faction, they had to do missions to improve their relationship with the faction and then use their favorability to exchange for the basic knowledge (of course, they could also spend money to buy it, but it was not cost-effective). Han Xiao's move helped the players to skip this process and cut them off in advance.

In just a short while, there were hundreds of players learning the basic knowledge from him, which was equivalent to 100,000 EXP, and this number was still rising.

The business was booming, and Han Xiao was very calm like Jiang Taigong waiting for the fish to take the bait. He dealt with the players while leisurely browsing the forums.

Players from all the novice planets were sharing information, and the players from Big Horn Village were excitedly promoting Han Xiao on the forums. He was the first high-level character to appear in the novice village of all the novice planets, and his popularity was very high. Posts about him kept being pushed up.

"This high-level character sells cheap guns and ammunition, and the quality is excellent. As long as the favorability is above five, you can learn the skills. Not only are there general skills such as Basic Shooting and Basic Combat, but there are also a few basic knowledge of the Mechanic class, and you can change your class immediately."

"Damn, I've never seen such a high-level figure before."

"I can actually learn the knowledge of Job Advancement! Big Horn Mountain, right? I'll be right there! "

"Damn, we're in another continent. We can't go there."

"Why can't we meet any high-ranking figures in other places?"

"Extremely deadly? Do you have the guts to try and see how strong it is? If you die, it's my fault. I don't have much money, so I can only shoot a plane as compensation. "

Many posts were accompanied by screenshots. Han Xiao, who was dressed in black, had successfully appeared on screen. Many people expressed great appreciation for his black windbreaker and black gloves. He was handsome and cool. As long as one did not look at his middle-aged salted fish face, he would definitely be a male model.

Even the players from the other novice planets were excitedly discussing the combat power of the high-level characters. The forum had automatic translation, so there was no need to worry about language problems.

"Players are very interested in the combat power of high-level characters …" Han Xiao had a flash of inspiration, and a new idea popped up in his mind. If he displayed his strength, he would be able to attract more people to switch to the Mechanic class. Although he had released the basic knowledge, many players were still observing. After all, there were still many players who were not interested in the Mechanic class and doubted the combat power of the Mechanic class. Most players were looking for excitement, so the introduction of the Pugilist class and the Esper class was naturally more to their liking.

It had to be said that their doubts were correct. The Mechanic class was indeed not strong in the early stages, but … that did not include Han Xiao. He secretly smiled and prepared to mislead the players. He knew the players too well. They were a bunch of immoral people who would choose whichever class they thought was strong.

Imparting skills was pure profit for Han Xiao. There were already hundreds of players who had learned the basic knowledge of the Mechanic class. If he could trick half of the players in Big Horn Mountain into becoming Mechanics, he would directly gain millions of experience points.

The profit from this was shocking!

Han Xiao was excited.

"Coincidentally, the evacuation team of the Germinal Organization will arrive in a few days. This is the perfect opportunity to make a move."

…

Xidu.

Mad Blade Angry Sword was crestfallen. He did not eat or drink for the past few days. Every day without Han Xiao felt like a year.

Out of boredom, Mad Blade Angry Sword was browsing the forums. Suddenly, he saw a bunch of hot posts from the players in Big Horn Mountain. It was the interface of Han Xiao's item sale.

"Lightweight Mechanical Arm?"

Mad Blade Angry Sword suddenly stood up with a look of surprise on his face.

He remembered that Han Xiao had shown this machine before. As Han Xiao had always covered his face before, Mad Blade Angry Sword had a guess.

Could it be that Black Phantom was Han Xiao?

"I must find him!"

…

In order to increase Han Xiao's favorability to more than five points, the players who were lacking money went to Big Horn Mountain Settlement to accept missions to earn money. The players who surrounded Han Xiao had decreased by a lot.

Your item [Lightweight Mechanical Arm] has been sold!

Han Xiao was shocked.

He had set the price at 20,000, and there were people who could afford it. He looked at the dozens of players in front of him. The ID of the leader was' Jade Green Sky '. Seeing this person's name, Han Xiao suddenly understood. Jade Green Sky was the leader of a big guild in China, 'Sky Territory'. With the guild's financial resources, of course, he could afford it.

Jade Green Sky was wearing a set of hand-sewn leather armor. His equipment was a level better than the open beta players. He was a closed beta player. During the closed beta, he took a few core members to other places to explore the map. He heard about Black Phantom from the other members of the open beta and decided to lead the team back.

Although Jade Green Sky had not changed his class yet, he was preparing to become a Pugilist. He saw the attributes of the Lightweight Mechanical Arm at first glance. Although he could not use it now, he bought it and stored it in the warehouse in case Black Phantom suddenly left. It was a golden opportunity.

"There are a lot of good items." The people of Sky Territory looked at the shop list and praised.

Unfortunately, each of them had to spend 2,500 to get five favorability points. Although Sky Territory was a big guild, they did not have much money now. Buying the Lightweight Mechanical Arm cost a lot of the guild's assets.

Han Xiao suddenly said, "An enemy team will pass by here in a few days. I need some people to help me set up traps in the forest. Are you guys free?"

Then, he set a mission and released it.

Level E difficulty. The mission was to set up traps in the forest. There was no limit to the type, and the reward was only 500 EXP. However, Han Xiao specially set up three favorability points as a reward, which was exactly what Sky Territory wanted.

Jade Green Sky immediately decided. "Everyone, accept the mission!"

Han Xiao smiled secretly. Using favorability points to attract players to accept the mission and also to supplement his business chain.

He could adjust the favorability points at will. Using the previous settings, he gave the favorability points a price. This method was actually very similar to the principle of currency. It made something seem to have value but was actually worthless. This attracted Sky Territory, Kill-all, and all kinds of guilds and players to accept the mission. It was very effective.

Han Xiao had always felt that the currency system was built on a pile of bubbles, so he had always held the belief that if you had money, you should spend it.

Money that you did not spend was a burden that dragged down your motivation to work! Just like "Black X Souls"!

A large number of players were tricked by Han Xiao to set up traps in the forest. The traps they could use were very simple — most of them were animal traps. Han Xiao took some time to take a look. The forest was densely packed with traps, and those with trypophobia would have goosebumps.

When the Germinal Organization's evacuation team arrived, they would definitely be shocked.
